# Odoo CRM | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Financial integration of sales inventory | The main link, “list or interactive entry - formation of customer and business opportunities - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether the financial integration of sales stocks actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Manufacturing and distribution | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - management of the disc, to verify whether manufacturing and distribution actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Electrical Client Management | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of a customer and business - push phase - triggers the next step - manage the double disk”, is to verify whether the power provider's customer management really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Integration of multi-company business platforms | Using “lists or interactive entry - formation of customers and business opportunities - push phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - manage the double drive, to verify whether integration of multi-corporate business platforms actually reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
